VM - Open Context.vi

Owning Palette: Variable Manager

Creates a new local Variable Context. The VI returns the handle of the context, which is used to refer to that context and access its variables. Each opened context must be closed when it is no longer needed. Use VM - Close Context.vi to close a context.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

Creator (top-level VI) is an optional parameter. It specifies a name of the context creator. If it contains an empty string (by default), the VI assumes that creator is the VI in the top of hierarchy it is called. The creator name is constant during the context lifetime.
Use VM - Context Info.vi in order to obtain a name of the context creator.
Use VM - Get list of contexts.vi in order to obtain handles of contexts that belong to the specified creator.
context life time is an optional parameter. It specifies intended lifetime of the context. This parameter together with the Creator defines a condition that the context is under operation (not loose).

0creator run top levelThe context is under operation while its creator is running as top-level VI. This is the default value.
1creator runningThe context is under operation while its creator belongs to any running hierarchy.
2creator in memoryThe context is under operation while its creator belongs to any running hierarchy.
3untill closedThe context is permanently under operation until it is closed.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
close loose contexts (F) is an optional parameter. If it is TRUE, the VI calls VM - Close loose contexts.vi in order to find and close loose contexts. Default value is FALSE.
VC Handle out returns the handle of the opened Variable Context.
err code contains a VarMan Engine error code identifying an error. If no error occurred, err code is equal to zero.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.

 

VM - Open Context.vi - details

The VI saves information on a creator of the context and a specifier of intended lifetime of the context. This information can help to search for loose contexts. Use VM - Close loose contexts.vi to look for loose contexts and close them. However, it cannot guarantee that all actually loose contexts are closed. Good practice is to explicitly close contexts.

Also see VarMan overview.
